summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing a second amendment to its senior secured convertible promissory note with J.J. Astor Co. The amendment increased principal to $2,266,650, raised the interest rate to 19%, and set repayment in 23 weekly installments of $104,187.65. Proceeds from an existing sales agreement with A.G.P. were increased to 90% for the lender. Conversion terms were modified to a price equal to the greater of 70% of the 20-day VWAP or the Nasdaq floor, subject to shareholder approval. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation; no change in control or strategic event is involved.
